description: Real-time solar wind from the active spacecraft (DSCOVR/ACE): plasma (proton speed km/s, density p/cm³, temperature K) plus interplanetary magnetic field (bt, and bz in GSE/GSM — sustained southward bz_gsm is what drives geomagnetic storms). 1-minute cadence, last 24 hours available.

window.description: How many trailing minutes of 1-minute samples to return: 5-minute (default, current conditions) | 1-hour | 2-hour | 1-day

name: solar_wind
